name.ja: 30MM ARMORED CORE VI FIRES OF RUBICON RaD CC-2000 ORBITER
name.en: 30MM ARMORED CORE VI FIRES OF RUBICON RaD CC-2000 ORBITER

description.ja: 『ARMORED CORE VI FIRES OF RUBICON』のアイテムが『30 MINUTES MISSIONS』シリーズで商品化。
description.en: "ARMORED CORE VI FIRES OF RUBICON " items are commercialized in the " 30 MINUTES MISSIONS" series.

description.ja: シリーズのキーコンセプト「シンプル組み立て」「カスタム遊び」のもと、RaD製AC「CC-2000 ORBITER」が登場！
description.en: Based on the series' key concepts of "simple assembly " and " custom play," RaD's AC " CC-2000 ORBITER" is now available!

description.ja: • 頭部、コア、腕部、脚部それぞれにシリーズ共通構造を採用し、ゲーム内同様に「アセンブル」をプラモデルで楽しめる。
description.en: • The head, core, arms, and legs each use the same structure as the series, allowing you to enjoy "assembling" the plastic model just like in the game.

description.ja: • 両肩武器と一部左手武器の取り付けには3mmジョイントを採用し様々なアセンブルに対応可能。
description.en: • 3mm joints are used to attach both shoulder weapons and some left-handed weapons, allowing for a variety of assemblies.

description.ja: • 速射型リニアライフル「LR-036 CURTIS」が付属。
description.en: • Rapid-fire linear rifle "LR-036 CURTIS" is included.

series: ARMORED CORE Ⅵ FIRES OF RUBICON
